shipping.policy:
FedEx will NOT deliver to PO Boxes or US Territories
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s).
We strive to ship orders out within
5 business days
of payment; however, during the holidays/Bad Weather and unforeseen circumstances there may be a slight delay,
Goodwill Industries of the Southern Piedmont will not be held responsible for items lost
or stolen within shipping route once they have left our facility. FedEx claims (for damaged items ONLY) are
filed on your behalf. We are not responsible for denied claims or delays on FedEx resolutions.
Items sold in "lots" will NOT be individually wrapped for shipping.
Damaged in Shipping
: If your order was damaged during shipment, you must notify
Customer Service via the Contact Seller link within seven (7) days of receipt
of your order. We are responsible to initiate the claim as the Shipper. We ask
that you keep the item in your possession until the conclusion of our claim. We
will need photos of the damage, including pictures of the shipping box (all 4 sides) and
packaging. We will not be able to file a claim without photos of the above
mentioned items.
If we do not have photos of the shipping box, we will only refund item total, less shipping and handling.
**
Packages returned by FedEx will be subject to additional shipping charges.
Combined Shipping -
Eligible items may be combined to save on shipping charges if the auctions close within 7 days of each other, are safe to ship in one box.
There is a 20lb combined shipping limit
. Once paid for, items are no longer eligible to be combined. Once a combined shipping charge has been calculated for an order, no additional items may be added to an order.
Mixed or Flat-Rate Shipping -
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
ALL JEWELRY ITEMS are shipped in a box with RED ALERT Security Tape.
Signature Verification
: For all orders $250 or more, packages must be signed for by an adult in the household.

category: For The Home > Home Decor > Quilts
description:
Casaluna
Heavyweight Linen Blend Quilt
Full / Queen Size, Mineral Blue
Designed for understated bedroom styling, this Casaluna quilt combines a rich washed texture with balanced thermal weight. The front face features a breathable linen and rayon blend that offers natural drape and softness, backed and filled with pure cotton for breathable comfort. Its box-stitched grid pattern provides structural stability and even fill distribution while imparting a clean, modern aesthetic.
Sized for Full or Queen beds, measuring 90 inches wide by 94 inches long
Woven blend of 70% rayon and 30% linen on face with 100% cotton backing and fill
Classic grid box stitching secures filling and maintains consistent loft
Certified OEKO-TEX Made in Green textile production
Condition:
New with original tags and fabric strap packaging attached. The quilt remains neatly rolled and bundled in its retail presentation with no tears, pulls, fading, or staining observed.
State Tax:
Goodwill Industries of the Southern Piedmont is required by law to collect state taxes.
Payment Extensions -
We will no longer extend any payment deadlines.
Upcycle Lots
-
Every item we offer has its own characterlike happy little accidents that tell a story. You may find signs of wear such as small tears, fading, stains, or missing pieces. These details are part of what makes each piece special, like brushstrokes on a canvas.
We invite you to take a good look at the photos, which show the item's condition and charm. All items are sold just as they are, and because each one is unique, we aren't able to accept returns or offer refunds.
Thanks for bringing a little joy to something that's ready for a new chapter.

Geode, Banded Agate, and Polished Stone
This three-piece mineral lot features a selection of geological specimens, including a crystal-lined geode and polished agate sections. description:
Natural Selenite Crystal
Carved Skyscraper Tower Point
White Satin Spar Gypsum, Approximately 8.5-9 Inches Tall
Carved natural selenite crystal tower sculpted in an architectural stepped skyscraper formation. Selenite, a crystalline variety of gypsum prized for its fibrous formation and luminous optical chatoyancy, is a staple in mineral collecting, energy practices, and contemporary interior decor. This substantial display specimen showcases translucent columnar layers that reflect and diffuse ambient light throughout its tiered structure.
Sculpted from natural white satin spar selenite with linear crystalline striations
Distinctive multi-tiered skyscraper silhouette tapering to a faceted peak
Flat, unpolished saw-cut base ensuring stable freestanding tabletop display
Measures approximately 8.5 to 9 inches tall by 3.25 to 3.5 inches in base diameter
Condition:
Very good condition. Presents characteristic natural mineral features including internal cleavage planes, layered textures, and minor edge roughness typical of hand-carved soft gypsum crystal. The cut base is structurally sound and stands firmly upright.

Tea cups bears the stamped gold Mintons crowned globe hallmark alongside the custom "Tiffany & Co. New York / Made in England" retailer mark.
Saucers bear stamped gold Mintons crowned hallmark alongside "Davis Collamore & Co. / FIFTH AVE & 37TH ST/ NEW YORK."
